hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT (Lupin Q1 FY27 press release, 6 Aug 2026, secondary web summary; NSE PDF text not in dossier): revenue ~Rs8,217-8,277 cr (+32-33% YoY), EBITDA ~Rs2,463 cr (~30%), US ~USD 363-366m. MANAGEMENT CLAIM: FY27 US revenue USD 1.1-1.2bn, normalised US run-rate USD 250-280m/qtr, EBITDA margin guide ~24-25%.

bear.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: gTolvaptan/other gRevlimid-type exclusivities fade faster, US run-rate at low end of mgmt $250-280m/qtr, EBITDA margin ~21%, multiple compresses to 15x.

base.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: FY27 EPS ~Rs118, FY28 dips then recovers; mgmt FY27 EBITDA margin guide 24-25%, US $1.1-1.2bn; India/respiratory/ROW growth offsets US step-down.

bull.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: new launches (inhalers, Apixaban 505(b)(2), biosimilars) replace exclusivity income; margin held ~27%.

extreme_bull.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: complex-generic/specialty mix lifts margin ~29% and rerates toward 22x.

risk.order_firmness: n/a: pharma, no order book; FDA approvals are not revenue

thesis: Lupin's Q1 FY27 is a record, but it sits on peak one-off exclusivity income (gTolvaptan) that management itself says steps down: US run-rate guided USD 250-280m/qtr vs ~USD 365m reported, EBITDA margin guide 24-25% vs ~30% in Q1. The 17x TTM P/E looks cheap only on peak earnings. Pipeline (inhalers, Apixaban 505(b)(2), biosimilars, many FDA approvals) is real but each is small against the step-down. Probability-weighted EV is low; this is a cyclical-peak earnings case, not an inflection. Wait for evidence that normalised earnings hold.
